newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MUNICIPAL FOCUS - flat to weaker, more issues.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MUNICIPAL FOCUS - flat to weaker, more issues.

text.p: U.S. municipal bond prices, holding their own in another busy day of new issues, were quoted flat to slightly weaker in mild secondary trade.
Munis followed Treasuries, which were off on the long end 5/32 to yield 6.45 percent, an improvement from earlier trade.
An underwriter said that new issues priced on Wednesday, including a $200 million New York Triborough Birdge and Tunnel Authority revenue bond offering, do not appear to be weakening.
He also said two large issues priced on Tuesday, a $500 million New York Local Government Assistance Corp issue and a $146 Monroe County, N.Y., GO issue went well.
A trader said the market was off and still "can't get out of it's own way." Retail investors are still entraced by the stock market, he said.
On Tuesday, Municipal bond prices ended flat to up 1/4 point.

Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $1.31 billion in 50 offerings for Wednesday. Competitive sales total $552 million in 31 offerings and negotiated sales total $767 million in 19 offerings.
In debt futures, the December municipal contract was off 1/32 at 117-3/32. The December T-bond contract was off 4/32 at 115-3/32. The MOB spread was 64 ticks.
